messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi, I’ve been looking at my Silver Rewards Card statements and I think some of my cash back rewards might be wrong. Can you help me check?

I can help — I just need to verify your identity before I can look at your card statements and reward details.

Please tell me which account identifier you’d like to use so I can look up your account: either your Rho user ID, the email on the account, or your full name (case-sensitive). After I look up the account, I’ll ask you to confirm 2 of these 4 items: date of birth, email, phone number, or address.

Also tell me:
- Which card (Silver Rewards Card) — confirmed — and
- Which statement months or date range you want me to check (e.g., Apr 2026–Jun 2026), and
- Any specific transactions or rewards entries that look incorrect (if you know them).

If you’d prefer a human agent instead, say so and I’ll transfer you.

You can look me up by my full name: **Kenji Tanaka**.

- Card: **Silver Rewards Card** (confirmed)
- Date range to check: **the most recent couple of months** (I don’t have the exact statement months in front of me right now)
- Specific transactions: **I’m not sure which ones**—I just noticed the cash back points seemed “off” on a few purchases when I skimmed my transaction history.

Let me know what 2 items you want me to confirm for verification.
